notes: How it works: you play Outer Wilds, land on a planet and press F6 to play real Minecraft there: break and place blocks, open your inventory, light TNT. Your builds stay on the planet through every time loop.

To start: Play starts Minecraft first. Then start Outer Wilds from the Outer Wilds Mod Manager. Once they link, Minecraft opens its own void world; in Outer Wilds, land, stand on the ground and press F6.

Keys: F6 enters and leaves Minecraft mode, O opens Minecraft's menu, F5 switches to third person, Esc pauses Outer Wilds or closes a Minecraft screen. The keys can be changed in the Mod Manager's OWCraft settings.

You need Outer Wilds on Steam (Windows) and Minecraft: Java Edition. Once, by hand: install the Outer Wilds Mod Manager, start Outer Wilds from it once, then choose Install From > Zip and pick Yaekai.OWCraft-0.1.1.zip from this mod's folder (Open folder in the app).

Single player only. Restore deletes the Minecraft side and the zip copy; remove OWCraft in the Mod Manager yourself. Known limits: glass, water and ice look opaque, the Outer Wilds player does not collide with placed blocks, no day/night sync, no Nether.
Beta ("experimental, but playable", tested on one PC): report bugs to the author with the Report a bug link.
